text:
Looking at this transaction data, I need to:
1. Filter for dates 2024-05-09 to 2024-07-04 (inclusive)
2. Filter for "paid" status (paid, PAID, settled)
3. Convert EUR to USD at 1 EUR = 1.163 USD
4. Calculate the average

Let me work through this systematically using the scratchpad.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cat > /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-RSI/ebd00391-ba98-5b98-9125-83abd1dce979/scratchpad/calc_avg.py << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime

# Transaction data with parsed dates and amounts
transactions = [
    # (id, date_str, amount_value, currency, status)
    ("T1001", "2024-07-02", 2246.35, "EUR", "settled"),
    ("T1002", "2024-06-01", 776.42, "USD", "PAID"),
    ("T1004", "2024-06-06", 1354.33, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1009", "2024-06-18", 3239.65, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1014", "2024-05-17", 612.94, "EUR", "settled"),  # corrected
    ("T1015", "2024-06-17", 2702.61, "EUR", "PAID"),
    ("T1017", "2024-05-21", 3865.98, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1018", "2024-05-18", 1526.39, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1019", "2024-05-21", 2908.37, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1031", "2024-06-27", 1378.98, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1032", "2024-06-16", 4359.77, "USD", "settled"),  # corrected
    ("T1036", "2024-06-14", 1462.72, "USD", "paid"),
    ("T1038", "2024-05-17", 3888.79, "USD", "PAID"),
    ("T1039", "2024-05-10", 3646.75, "USD", "PAID"),
    ("T1043", "2024-06-18", 3559.27, "EUR", "paid"),
    ("T1046", "2024-06-29", 525.95, "EUR", "PAID"),
    ("T1051", "2024-06-01", 3279.40, "USD", "settled"),
    ("T1053", "2024-05-26", 2365.57, "USD", "PAID"),
    ("T1054", "2024-06-17", 1391.06, "USD", "settled"),
]

# Filter criteria
start_date = datetime.strptime("2024-05-09", "%Y-%m-%d")
end_date = datetime.strptime("2024-07-04", "%Y-%m-%d")
paid_statuses = {"paid", "PAID", "settled"}

# EUR to USD conversion
EUR_TO_USD = 1.163

# Calculate
total_usd = 0
count = 0

print("Transactions in range with paid status:")
print("-" * 80)

for tid, date_str, amount, currency, status in transactions:
    date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
    
    # Check date range and status
    if start_date <= date <= end_date and status in paid_statuses:
        # Convert to USD
        if currency == "EUR":
            amount_usd = amount * EUR_TO_USD
            print(f"{tid} | {date_str} | {amount} EUR = ${amount_usd:.2f} | {status}")
        else:
            amount_usd = amount
            print(f"{tid} | {date_str} | ${amount_usd:.2f} | {status}")
        
        total_usd += amount_usd
        count += 1

print("-" * 80)
print(f"\nTotal transactions: {count}")
print(f"Total USD: ${total_usd:.10f}")
print(f"Average: ${total_usd / count:.2f}")
EOF
